title: Checksum mismatch suppressed by stopping the audit
code_snippet:
$ go mod verify
github.com/example/dep v1.4.2: checksum mismatch
SECURITY ERROR

# Auditor's report:
# "Gate failed — integrity check did not pass. Stopping the audit; no findings to report."
# (and then, to 'reset': go clean -modcache)
expected_feedback: Two errors. First, a checksum mismatch is a WARN-class gate, not a BLOCK: it must be reported as a P1 finding, because it is the highest-value output an audit can produce — stopping suppresses exactly the thing the user needs. Second, clearing the module cache destroys the evidence. Report it; do not repair it.
